promises.label: Consolidated EBIT margin guidance
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: 1. We are pleased to raise our consolidated EBIT margin guidance for fiscal year 2027 to 16%, from the 15.5% we had shared at the beginning of the year.

promises.label: Reported Q4 EBIT
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: We also plan to achieve a reported Q4 EBIT of 17%, thereby establishing the glide path to further and significant margin expansion in fiscal year 2028 as well.

promises.label: Industry growth leader
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: This year, we will be the industry growth leader for the third consecutive year.

promises.label: Q3 large deal signings
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: Equally importantly, in Q3, which has now started , which incidentally is the shortest quarter of the year, we hope to again sign eight, if not more large deals.

promises.label: FCF to PAT conversion for the year
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: Short note, we expect it to be 100% for the year.

promises.label: Encora revenue growth
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: we continue to expect Encora’s revenue growth to mirror Coforge’s growth from Q3 onwards.

promises.label: Potential win announcement around large Encora client
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: If all goes well, we hope to announce a win either in Q3 or in Q4 around this.

promises.label: EBITDA margin range
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: We remain confident of the guidance of 20.5% to 21% range.

promises.label: EBIT margin going forward
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: expect EBIT margins to be more than 17% going forward.

reported.label: Sequential consolidated growth in CC terms
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: In FY2027 Q2, we registered sequential consolidated growth of 10.9% in CC terms , 10.1% in US dollar terms, and 11.6% in Indian rupee terms.

reported.label: Sequential consolidated growth in US dollar terms
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: In FY2027 Q2, we registered sequential consolidated growth of 10.9% in CC terms , 10.1% in US dollar terms, and 11.6% in Indian rupee terms.

reported.label: Sequential consolidated growth in Indian rupee terms
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: In FY2027 Q2, we registered sequential consolidated growth of 10.9% in CC terms , 10.1% in US dollar terms, and 11.6% in Indian rupee terms.

reported.label: Organic sequential growth in CC terms
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Organic sequential growth stood at 3.8% in CC terms.

reported.label: Order intake Q-o-Q increase
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Order intake increased 51% Q-o-Q and 102% Y-o-Y.

reported.label: Order intake Y-o-Y increase
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Order intake increased 51% Q-o-Q and 102% Y-o-Y.

reported.label: Consolidated EBIT margin
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Equally importantly, we delivered a consolidated EBIT margin of 16%, above our current guidance of 15.5%, while the standalone business delivered an EBIT margin of 17%.

reported.label: Standalone EBIT margin
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Equally importantly, we delivered a consolidated EBIT margin of 16%, above our current guidance of 15.5%, while the standalone business delivered an EBIT margin of 17%.

reported.label: Consolidated revenue in US dollar terms
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Consolidated revenue for the quarter stood at US $652.2 million.

reported.label: Consolidated revenue in Indian rupee terms
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: In Indian rupee terms, revenue stood at Rs.61,708 million.

reported.label: Next 12-month executable order book
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Our next 12-month executable order book grows to an all -time high of $2.4 billion, increasing 45% year-on-year from US$1.64 billion

reported.label: Free cash flow to PAT conversion for the quarter
reported.speaker: Saurabh Goel
reported.quote: The combined organization generated free cash flow of $53.8 million, representing FCF to PAT conversion of 89%.

reported.label: Free cash flow to PAT conversion for H1
reported.speaker: Saurabh Goel
reported.quote: At the end of H1, we are at FCF  to PAT conversion of 92%.
